claims.evidence: Witness report shows used tyres only; no readable brand/origin/DOT or markings confirming Belgium or 'first grade' quality.

risks.risk: Tyre size/rim diameter unknown, so the buyer may not be able to fit them to the vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the tyre sidewall showing full size (e.g., width/aspect/rim) and any model/series text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown sizes and sold as used tyres with fitment risk.

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty (tread depth, sidewall cracks, bulges, punctures/repairs) could make some tyres unsafe or near-worn-out.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of multiple tyres: tread depth area, sidewall for cracks, and any visible punctures/repairs/bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case used condition (possible low tread and potential damage), assuming not roadworthy without inspection.

risks.risk: Matching/compatibility risk: tyres may not be the same size/type or may not be matching pairs/sets.
risks.proof: A shot showing the sidewall markings for at least 4 tyres (front/rear candidates) to confirm same size and type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-matching used tyres (lower value than a complete matching set).

risks.risk: Age/DOT date unknown; older tyres can be brittle even if tread looks okay.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of DOT date code on several tyres.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tyres with unknown age.

risks.risk: Recap/newness claim cannot be verified; tyres could be recapped or heavily worn.
risks.proof: Close-up of tread/sidewall for signs of recap seams and any retread indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used tyres with no premium for 'first grade'.

risks.risk: Rims/wheels may not be included (photos show tyres; rims only partially visible in background).
risks.proof: A clear photo showing whether rims are included with the tyres (full view of a tyre mounted on a rim, or a statement with a photo of rims separately).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tyres only (no rims included).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the tyre sidewall showing the full size and model/series text (for at least 2 tyres).
Send close-ups of tread and sidewalls for several tyres showing any cracks, bulges, punctures, or repairs.
Send photos of the DOT date code for multiple tyres.
Confirm whether all tyres are the same size/type and whether they are matching pairs/sets (show sidewall markings across the set).
Confirm whether rims are included; send a photo of tyres mounted on rims or rims shown separately.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as used car tyres, so it can be priced at a worst-case used-tyre value. The seller’s 'Belgium first grade' claim is not verifiable from the report, and key fitment/condition details are missing, so pricing should assume the lowest practical case until proof is provided.
